task.ques: Find EV charging supported parking closest to Smithsonian museum.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: 424 11th St. NW (1101 Pennsylvania Ave.) – Garage is the closest EV-charging parking found for the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History: a 7-minute walk (0.3 mile).

I used the National Museum of Natural History on the National Mall as “Smithsonian museum.” SpotHero ranks this garage first as “Shortest Walk” with the EV Charging filter applied and Sort by Distance selected. The garage’s detail panel lists EV Charging; ParkChirp independently confirms the amenity and the entrance at 424 11th Street NW.

Checked for October 28, 2026, 10 AM–5 PM. Displayed total: $25.44, with exit automatically extended to 6 PM. Height limit: 6 ft 4 in; standard-size vehicles only.

Sources:
https://spothero.com/search?kind=destination&id=5934&destination_id=5934&starts=2026-10-28T10%3A00&ends=2026-10-28T17%3A00&view=dl&hide_event_modal=true&spot-id=39321
https://parkchirp.com/facilities/1101-penn-ave-nw-garage/

Evidence: final.png shows the garage name, walking distance, EV Charging amenity, filter count, distance sort and search dates together.
